The '''XiX blaster pistol''' was a type of [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] that was made by [[Galinolo]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Starship/Legends|starship]] racer [[Siro Simito]] owned one.
